comparison.objective: Move a shore-power cord fully onto a dock and insert its plug into a pedestal socket, versus tang removal.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cord management plus plug insertion versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, bimanual hammering, fracture regulation, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Cord clear of water and fender board, plug fully inserted, and released versus four tangs fractured and contained with no assembly damage. Numeric tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Despite precision alignment, the central tested outcome is cable routing and connector insertion, not controlled fracture and loose-part containment.
